{{Top}} {{Conjecture}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:imp_deck_officer_trask.png]] |name=Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Trask) |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[9 ABY]], [[Trask]]The events of "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]," including the [[deck officer]]'s appearance and [[death]], took place in [[9 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:MandoDate|here]]. |species=[[Human]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Grey]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Light |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Gideon's Imperial remnant]] |masters= |apprentices=}} {{Quote|We need to hold them off until we can make the jump to hyperspace.|The deck officer, to his stormtroopers|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''deck officer''' served in a [[Galactic Empire]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. He served on a [[Unidentified Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]], which was [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|attacked]] above the [[moon]] [[Trask]] in [[9 ABY]] by four [[Mandalorian]]s. The [[deck officer]] was ordered to hold the attackers off at the cargo bay, but quickly had his [[stormtrooper]]s seal off the Mandalorians in the cargo control area. He informed his [[Unidentified Imperial captain|captain]], but was flushed out of the Gozanti when the attackers opened the cargo bay doors. ==Biography== {{Quote|Think we have them trapped, sir.''"
"''Trapped them where?''"
"''In the cargo control area.|The deck officer and the captain|}} During the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic Era|reign]], the [[deck officer]] served as part of the [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. In [[9 ABY]], he served aboard a [[Unidentified Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]], holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. During the [[Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier's]] departure from the [[Water|estuary]] [[moon]] [[Trask]], the [[starship]] was [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|boarded]] by four [[Mandalorian]]s, [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], [[Din Djarin]], [[Koska Reeves]], and [[Axe Woves]]. A number of [[stormtrooper]]s aboard soon began amassing at the cargo bay where the [[deck officer]] was present. The officer asked the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], over his [[comlink]], what was happening. The [[Unidentified Imperial security officer (Trask)|security officer]] informed the deck officer that the Mandalorians were approaching his position, the cruiser's [[Unidentified Imperial captain|captain]] ordering him to hold the infiltrators off until the vessel entered [[hyperspace]]. [[File:ImpDeckOfficerStandsGround-TMCh11.png|thumb|left|280px|The deck officer stands with his stormtroopers to defend the cargo bay.]] The deck officer, drawing his [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]], relayed his orders to his stormtroopers as they took aim at the Mandalorians' predicted entry point, a lift at the end of the corridor extending from the cargo bay. The lift door eventually opened, and the Mandalorians engaged the deck officer's [[trooper]]s, initially killing several of them. After firing some shots at the Mandalorians, the deck officer took cover and ordered for the doors in the hallway to the cargo bay to be closed. When a stormtrooper asked which one, the officer replied "all of them." The stormtrooper closed the door behind the Mandalorians, and the deck officer insisted that all the doors must be closed, the trooper carrying out the order. The infiltrators were subsequently trapped in the cargo control area next to the cargo bay, and the officer informed the captain of this. That was when the Mandalorians used the control area to open the cargo bay doors, flushing the deck officer and his stormtroopers out of the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier, plummeting towards Trask. The security officer reached out to the cargo bay, but only got a response from Kryze, who had taken the deck officer's comlink. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Close all of them! Close all the doors!|The deck officer gives orders to a stormtrooper|}} [[File:ImpDeckOfficerCowers-TMCh11.png|thumb|right|280px|The deck officer cowered in fear upon seeing Mandalorians]] The deck officer was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin, blue [[eye]]s and white [[hair]]. Having been ordered to buy time for the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier to jump into hyperspace, the officer confidently repeated the orders to his stormtroopers and stood in the open with his [[blaster]] raised. When his troopers engaged the Mandalorians, though, he quickly took cover behind a terminal in fear, insistently telling a stormtrooper to close all of the doors around their opponents. The deck officer was unaware of the abilities the Mandalorians possessed in the cargo control area until the enemies used it to flush the officer and his men out of the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Close the doors!''"
"''Which one?''"
"''All of them! All of them!|The deck officer and a stormtrooper|}} The deck officer [[Clothing|wore]] the standard [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of an Imperial naval officer, including an [[Imperial kepi]] and a [[code cylinder]] attached below his left shoulder. He wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his left [[breast]] with two red bars above two blue, which signified the rank of lieutenant.''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' The deck officer carried an SE-14r light [[repeating blaster]] in a holster and used it to briefly fire upon the attacking Mandalorians. He also used a comlink to speak with the bridge of the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Cruiser he served on. ==Behind the scenes== The deck officer appeared in "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]] and released on [[November 13]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}} Credited as "Deck Officer," he was played by [[Kevin Dorff]]. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 3|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' 3]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Oficial de cubierta Imperial no identificado (Trask) |ja=名称不明の帝国軍甲板士官 |ka=გემბანის უცნობი იმპერიელი ოფიცერი (ტრასკი) }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of Gideon's Imperial remnant]]
